# Moor Treasure Maps: Rewards Data Mining & All Locations

![Moor Treasure Maps: Rewards Datamining & All Locations](/uploads/503_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![MonaLisa](/public/avatar_MonaLisa_ml1080.png) 

Treasure maps show **locations** with buried supplies in the game. To find the location, the **treasure map** must be in your inventory. The more treasure cards you have in your inventory for a location, the more can be dug up at the same time.

Treasure maps have **no carrying weight** and can therefore be stored in large quantities in the inventory. Supplies that can be unearthed include: **Weapons, Armor, Mods, Blueprints, Scrap, Chems, Food.**

In addition to the treasure maps and locations, there is also **data mining** with the possible rewards per area, as well as general rewards and rewards for teammates.

### Index

## Bog treasure maps

### Moor Treasure Map 01

From the cave in Hopwell, head east. There is a small hut on the mountains. Not far from the door entrance is a small rock where the hill with the treasure is.

### Moor Treasure Map 02

Just north of the Mottenbude fast travel at the end of the railway line, there is the hill on the right in front of a tunnel entrance with an overturned wagon.

### Moor Treasure Map 03

Follow the road at the Southern Belle Motel fast travel point southwest until you see a yellow truck. There is a hill on the side of the road.

### Moor Treasure Map 04

The treasure can be found under the bridge at the Crevasse dam. Go west along the river bank. There is a school bus on the left side of the bridge.

### Moor Treasure Map 05

This treasure is difficult to find. The hill is located at the location shown on the map, in the middle of the tall grass between the Excelsior Model Home and Thunder Mountain Power Plant. Starting from the Thunder Mountain Power Plant, go under the road bridge so that the power plant is on the other side of the road bridge. Go to the pillar with the red arrow in the picture. Always run straight ahead. It's quite a distance to walk. The screenshot shows a shot with the free camera to better clarify the position.
